ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three vertically arranged D-type flip-flops, their Q outputs are respectively labeled P, Q, R, and they are triggered by the same Clock. The D input of the middle flip-flop comes from an OR-shaped gate with an output inversion bubble, namely a NOR gate, whose inputs are provided by feedback lines, corresponding to P and R. The D input of the lower flip-flop comes from an AND gate, whose inputs correspond to Q and the inverted signal of R. The D input of the upper flip-flop is determined by the feedback connection; according to the connection in the figure, when the current PQR = 010 this D input is low level. Reasoning: Before the given clock edge arrives, P=0, Q=1, R=0. The input of the upper flip-flop D_P=0. The input of the middle flip-flop D_Q=NOR(P,R)=~(0+0)=1. The input of the lower flip-flop D_R=Q·R̄=1·1=1. D flip-flops simultaneously load their respective D inputs at the clock edge, so after the clock edge PQR = 011.

raw_record.question_text:
Consider the circuit involving three D-type flip-flops used in a certain type of counter configuration.

If at some instance prior to the occurrence of the clock edge, P, Q, and R have values 0, 1, and 0 respectively, what shall be the value of PQR after the clock edge?

method.method_draft: First describe the image connections, then compute the D inputs. The upper flip-flop D input is low for present PQR = 010. The middle flip-flop D input is the NOR of P and R, so it is ~(0 + 0) = 1. The lower flip-flop D input is Q AND R-bar, so it is 1 · 1 = 1. At the clock edge the D values are loaded simultaneously, giving next PQR = 011.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有三个上下排列的 D 型触发器，它们的 Q 输出分别标为 P、Q、R，并由同一个 Clock 触发。中间触发器的 D 输入来自一个带输出反相泡的 OR 形门，即 NOR 门，其输入由反馈线提供，对应 P 和 R。下方触发器的 D 输入来自一个 AND 门，其输入对应 Q 与 R 的反相信号。上方触发器的 D 输入由反馈连接决定；按图中连接，在当前 PQR = 010 时该 D 输入为低电平。推理：给定时钟沿到来前 P=0、Q=1、R=0。上方触发器的输入 D_P=0。中间触发器的输入 D_Q=NOR(P,R)=~(0+0)=1。下方触发器的输入 D_R=Q·R̄=1·1=1。D 触发器在时钟沿同时装载各自 D 输入，所以时钟沿后 PQR = 011。
